name: ODRL Party
abstract: W3C ODRL 2.2 Party (a person, organization or agent identified by IRI) or PartyCollection (a group of parties, identified by @id, or by odrl:source narrowed with odrl:refinement). A Party may be typed odrl:Party, schema:Person or schema:Organization (ODRL declares Party a subclass of these), and a schema.org-typed party is validated by the person or organization block. Used for the assigner and assignee of ODRL rules and policies. Uses building blocks: odrlConstraint (odrlProperties), person, organization (schemaorgProperties), objectReference (cdifDataType).
